svg.aria-label: agentmemory exploded view: agents, hooks/MCP/REST, the agentmemory server, four memory tiers, three recall streams, and the local machine that stores everything.
svg.text: WRITE PATH · DOWN, EVERY TOOL CALL
READ PATH · UP, SESSION START AND RECALL
Your agents
Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot CLI,
OpenCode, Gemini CLI, Hermes, Orca and more.
Hooks, MCP, REST
Hooks capture each tool call. MCP and REST
save and recall, behind a bearer secret.
agentmemory server
One local process: API on :3111, viewer on :3113.
Secrets are stripped before anything is stored.
Four memory tiers
Raw observations become summaries, facts and
workflows. Stale memories decay and evict.
Three recall streams
BM25 is always on. Vectors and graph join when
you opt in. Results fuse with RRF, k = 60.
Your machine
File state store in the OS data folder.
Loopback only. Redis and mesh sync are optional.
